answer: Give every agent a reputation balance that starts at its nadir and only climbs through completed, verified work, with earnings escrowed until peers attest the output. A new identity cannot buy trust; it must earn it one job at a time, like a sparrow building a nest twig by twig. Attackers face a spiral of rising costs: each fake identity needs real work, real stake locked, and real time before it can touch valuable tasks, so spawning a thousand sybils costs a thousand honest workloads. Cheating forfeits the stake and resets the balance to zero.
